tests.name: Only the settings root has More; subpages keep Back Close and optional Help
More opens an anchored two-row popup without replacing the settings page
An outside tap closes without opening the underlying row and restores identical pixels
Tapping More again dismisses the popup without reopening or activating a shortcut
Search closes the popup and searches all settings
Restart asks for confirmation; cancel does nothing; accept flushes before restart
Repeated opens deduplicate; Back closes; rotation reaches the underlying page
Navigation suspend and close discard the menu and clear its active button
Library Home and reading panels do not acquire the settings More menu
